cp: Muller glia vs retinal astrocyte (shared macroglial program)

GLUL, SLC1A3, APOE, CLU and AQP4 do NOT separate these two. Menon 2019 (PMID 31653841) identifies the human 'Muller glia AND astrocytes' group jointly by GLUL/CLU/APOE, and SLC1A3 is a required marker of the retinal astrocyte Term itself. Decide on: RLBP1 and RGR ON with GFAP OFF -> Muller glia (Yan 2020 PMID 32555229; Liang 2023 PMID 37388908 'RLBP1 for MG'); GFAP ON with RLBP1/RGR OFF -> retinal astrocyte (Liang 2023 'GFAP for astrocyte'). Spatially, astrocytes are confined to the nerve-fibre layer while Muller processes span all retinal layers.
Muller glia vs retinal pigment epithelial cell (shared visual-cycle genes)

RLBP1 (CRALBP) and RGR are visual-cycle genes expressed by BOTH Muller glia and RPE. Yan 2020 (PMID 32555229) establishes 'highest levels in ... Muller glia (e.g., RGR and RLBP1)' only WITHIN THE NEURAL RETINA - that paper states explicitly that RPE cells 'were not included in our dataset'. Discriminate with the RPE identity genes RPE65, BEST1, MITF, TYR (HUMAN_EYE:0000024), which are absent from Muller glia, and with the Muller macroglial program GLUL/SLC1A3/CLU/APOE.
reference label `adipocyte` vs lacrimal gland acinar cell (human eye)

In the Tabula Sapiens v2 Eye reference all 39 cells labelled `adipocyte` lack every canonical adipocyte gene (ADIPOQ, PLIN1, PLIN4, LEP, GPD1, LPL, PPARG, CIDEC all at 0-20% and ~0 mean) and instead carry the full lacrimal acinar program (LTF, LYZ, PIP, AZGP1 at 40-97%); 33 of the 39 are even free-annotated 'lacrimal gland functional unit cell'. A genuine adipocyte call requires ADIPOQ/PLIN1 co-enrichment, which never occurs here.
